select * from( select rownum RN, A.* from( select MEM.ID as USER_ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME as ORG_NAME ,count(CS.STUDENT_NO) as STUDENT_COUNT from CONSULTANT CON left join MEMBER MEM on (MEM.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG ORG on (ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CON.CONSULTANT_NO = CS.CONSULTANT_NO)
and MEM.NAME like '%' || #{name} || '%'
and MEM.NICKNAME like '%' || #{nickname} || '%'
and MEM.STATUS = #{status}
and ORG.NAME like '%' || #{orgName} || '%'
and exists ( select 1 from CONSULTANT CON2 left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS2 on (CON2.CONSULTANT_NO = CS2.CONSULTANT_NO) left join STUDENT STU2 on (STU2.STUDENT_NO = CS2.STUDENT_NO) where CON2.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO and STU2.NAME like '%' || #{studentName} || '%' )
group by MEM.ID ,MEM.NAME ,MEM.NICKNAME ,MEM.STATUS ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME
having count(CS.STUDENT_NO) = 0
having count(CS.STUDENT_NO) >= #{chargedCountStart}
having count(CS.STUDENT_NO) between least(#{chargedCountStart}, #{chargedCountEnd}) and greatest(#{chargedCountStart}, #{chargedCountEnd})
order by CONSULTANT_NO desc ) A where rownum <= #{endRow} ) B where RN >= #{startRow}

select count(*) from CONSULTANT CON left join MEMBER MEM on (MEM.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG ORG on (ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO)
and MEM.NAME like '%' || #{name} || '%'
and MEM.NICKNAME like '%' || #{nickname} || '%'
and MEM.STATUS = #{status}
and ORG.NAME like '%' || #{orgName} || '%'
and exists ( select 1 from CONSULTANT CON2 left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS2 on (CON2.CONSULTANT_NO = CS2.CONSULTANT_NO) left join STUDENT STU2 on (STU2.STUDENT_NO = CS2.STUDENT_NO) where CON2.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO and STU2.NAME like '%' || #{studentName} || '%' )
and exists( select 1 from CONSULTANT CON3 left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS3 on (CON3.CONSULTANT_NO = CS3.CONSULTANT_NO) where CON3.CONSULTANT_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO group by CON3.CONSULTANT_NO
having count(CS3.STUDENT_NO) = 0
having count(CS3.STUDENT_NO) >= #{chargedCountStart}
having count(CS3.STUDENT_NO) between least(#{chargedCountStart}, #{chargedCountEnd}) and greatest(#{chargedCountStart}, #{chargedCountEnd})
)
